## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle late-Míng commentary by [明昱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%98%B1) **Gāoyuán Míngyù** on the eight foundational Yogācāra texts compiled by [洪恩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B4%AA%E6%81%A9) in [KR6n0143](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0143) *Xiàngzōng bā yào* 相宗八要. Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X55n0900. The function-marker *zhe* 著 ("authored") is here equivalent to *jiě* (explication); the work supplies a running commentary on each of the eight texts in the *Bā yào* curriculum.

**Abstract**

The *Jiě* is Míngyù's principal late-Míng *Bā yào* commentary, presenting the eight foundational Yogācāra texts as an integrated reading-course in the strict Cí'ēn-school philological tradition that he champions throughout his corpus. Where Zhìxù's parallel [KR6n0145](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0145) *Bā yào zhíjiě* tends to read the texts integratively in light of his Tiāntái-Yogācāra synthesis, Míngyù's *Jiě* sticks closely to the Cí'ēn-school orthodox readings transmitted through Pǔtài and consolidated by Míngyù's own work. The *Jiě* together with Zhìxù's *Zhíjiě* are the two principal commentaries on Hóngēn's *Bā yào* compilation.

The dating window 1590–1620 brackets Míngyù's productive Wànlì period.
